title: 欧洲银行藏不住：法农信贷投行，增长超60%
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: One thing that has got a lot of headlines, a lot of attention over the last quarter for banks on both sides of the Atlantic has been trading revenue.
segments.zh: 过去一个季度，大西洋两岸的银行在交易收入方面备受关注。

segments.en: What can you tell us about how credit alcohol has performed there and how it stands up to its peers?
segments.zh: 您能谈谈法国农业信贷银行在此方面的表现，以及它如何与同行竞争？

segments.en: Well, we've performed very well in the CAB more generally and indeed in investment banking where the growth has been more than 60% this quarter.
segments.zh: 我们在企业和**银行业务方面表现非常出色，本季度增长超过60%。

segments.en: Fixed income commodities were stable, but what's interesting is that we have a very balanced mix in our CAB between capital markets and investment banking and structured finance and financing, which was also very strong.
segments.zh: 固定收益和大宗商品业务保持稳定，但有趣的是，我们在资本市场、投行、结构融资和融资业务之间实现了非常均衡的组合，这些业务也表现强劲。

segments.en: And so in fact, we had a very strong set of results overall thanks to very dynamic activity everywhere.
segments.zh: 事实上，由于各业务领域都非常活跃，我们整体业绩非常强劲。

segments.en: I just talked about equity and trading, but we had record inflows in insurance, record levels of assets under management in Amundi.
segments.zh: 刚才我提到了权益资产和交易，但我们在保险领域也创下了创纪录的流入，东方汇理的管理资产规模也创下新高。

segments.en: And in France, we had a very strong loan production and very high net interest income.
segments.zh: 在法国，我们的贷款产出非常强劲，净利息收入也很高。

segments.en: And so all in all, we reached record revenues 7.4 billion euros for critical essay growing by 7.7%.
segments.zh: 总体而言，我们实现了创纪录的74亿欧元收入，同比增长7.7%。

segments.en: And this allowed us to post very strong growth operating income growth of 11.4%.
segments.zh: 这使得我们的营业收入实现了11.4%的强劲增长。

segments.en: But we're also very profitable because our cost to income ratio decreased and is now below the target that we had set in our medium term plan, which is 55% and the return on tangible equity is at 14.3%.
segments.zh: 同时，我们的盈利能力也很强，成本收入比下降，已低于中期计划中设定的55%的目标，有形股本回报率为14.3%。
